Dinara Abbasova, PhD, EMBA
Associate Professor in Nuclear Chemistry
Vienna, Austria
en.profile: Dinara Abbasova holds a PhD in radiation chemistry from the Institute of Radiation Problems of the Azerbaijan National Academy of Sciences (2012) and the title of associate professor from the same institute (2016). She completed an Executive MBA at the Vienna University of Economics and Business in 2022–2024. From 2004 to 2012 she was head of the national INIS center, scientific secretary, and chromatography and quality manager at the Institute of Radiation Problems. Later posts include visiting professor at the Institute of Geology of the Polish Academy of Sciences, consultant at the International Atomic Energy Agency in 2017–2019 and 2023–2025, and scientist in knowledge management at HZDR in 2020–2023.

Consultant Orthopedic Surgeon and Head of Department
King Fahad Hospital and Sabya Hospital, Jizan, Saudi Arabia
en.profile: Azer Abdullayev is a consultant orthopedic surgeon and head of department at King Fahad Hospital and Sabya Hospital in Jizan, Saudi Arabia, where he has worked since 2004. He studied at the Azerbaijan Medical University from 1972 and completed a surgery internship in 1979. He received the Candidate of Medical Sciences degree in 1989 and the Doctor of Medical Sciences degree in 2012. From 1979 to 1989 he was a traumatologist-orthopedist at the Sharur Central Hospital, and from 1989 to 2004 he worked in the Department of Traumatology and Orthopedics of the Azerbaijan Medical University. His record includes more than 70 scientific articles, 2 teaching-methodical materials, and 6 invention patents.

en.profile: Shuay Abdullayev is a postdoctoral research associate at the Complex Carbohydrate Research Center of the University of Georgia in Athens, Georgia, in the group of Prof. David Crich. He received a PhD in organic chemistry from the Université du Québec à Montréal in 2021 for a thesis on the synthesis of therapeutic glyconanomaterials, supervised by Prof. René Roy. He previously studied chemistry at Baku State University and at the Université Claude Bernard Lyon 1. His publications focus on galectin ligands, sialylated oligosaccharides, neoglycolipids, and related carbohydrate chemistry. His Google Scholar h-index is 4.

Head of the Landau Department of Theoretical Physics
Moscow Institute of Physics and Technology, Dolgoprudny, Russian Federation
en.profile: Emil Ahmadov is head of the Landau Department of Theoretical Physics at the Moscow Institute of Physics and Technology and a leading researcher in that institute’s High Energy Physics Laboratory and at the Institute for Theoretical and Experimental Physics in Moscow. He defended his PhD on 11 April 1998 and his habilitation on 3 June 2009. From 2005 to 2020 he was a visiting professor or researcher at the Albert Einstein Institute in Golm, and in 2002 at KEK in Tsukuba. His work has been supported by state assignments and by grants from the Basis foundation, the Dynasty foundation, and the President of the Russian Federation.

en.profile: Shahin Ahmedoglu is a professor in the history of Islamic sects at the Faculty of Islamic Sciences of Kırıkkale University. He was appointed professor on 7 March 2022 and received the associate-professor title from the Interuniversity Council on 19 October 2015. He earned a doctorate in the history of Islamic sects from Ankara University (2001–2005), a master’s degree in the same field (1998–2001), and a bachelor’s degree in theology (1993–1998), all at Ankara University. Since 2023 he has chaired the department of basic Islamic sciences and the program in the history of Islamic sects.

He received a PhD in mathematics, specializing in probability theory and mathematical statistics, from St. Petersburg University in 1988, and a bachelor’s degree in mathematics there in 1981. He was deputy director academic of the University of Waterloo campus in the United Arab Emirates in 2009–2013, a lecturer at Waterloo in 2007–2009, and an assistant professor at McMaster University in 2000–2007. Earlier he was an associate professor at Odlar Yurdu University and at Azerbaijan State Economic University.

en.profile: Akif Alaferdov is a candidate of medical sciences and a traumatologist-orthopedist. He graduated from Karaganda State Medical Institute in 1972 and then worked in Kyrgyzstan. For many years he was a leading specialist and head of the traumatology and orthopedics department at the National Hospital. He chaired the bureau for rationalization proposals and inventions of the Ministry of Health of Kyrgyzstan. He is chairman of the Kyrgyzstan–Azerbaijan Society of Friendship and Cooperation and a founder of the Kyrgyz Club of Friends of Azerbaijan. From 1997 to 2013 he led the Azeri public association of Azerbaijanis in Kyrgyzstan. He holds the title Honored Doctor of the Kyrgyz Republic, awarded in 2003.

en.profile: Ismayil Aliyev is a professor at St. Petersburg State University of Economics, in the Department of Economics and Management of Enterprises and Industrial Complexes, a post he has held since 2023. He graduated in labor economics in 1992 from St. Petersburg State University of Economics and Finance, later received the Candidate of Economic Sciences degree, and in 2007 defended a doctoral dissertation on incomes and living standards in the context of improving the social policy of the Russian Federation. He received the associate-professor title in 2002 and the professor title in 2009. His record includes more than 150 publications, among them 12 textbooks and monographs, and supervision of 10 candidates of sciences and 2 doctors of sciences.

en.profile: Ramin Aliyev is a professor of guidance and psychological counseling at Hasan Kalyoncu University in Gaziantep. He was appointed professor on 27 March 2024, having served as associate professor there from 23 January 2019. He received a doctorate in educational psychology from Ankara University on 27 January 2011, a master’s degree in the same field on 1 September 2004, and a bachelor’s degree in guidance and psychological counseling on 18 July 2001. He is a member of the American Psychological Association and of the Turkish Psychological Counseling and Guidance Association.

en.profile: Aladdin Allahverdiyev is a professor at National Research University MIET. He has served as a department head at the Fonon Research Institute of the USSR Ministry of the Electronics Industry; as professor, department head, dean, vice-rector, and first vice-rector at the Moscow State Academy of Business Administration; and as professor, head of education quality, and deputy vice-rector at MIET. He is a graduate of the Faculty of Mechanics and Mathematics of Lomonosov Moscow State University and of its postgraduate program. His record includes more than 450 works, inventions, monographs, and textbooks; supervision of seven candidates of sciences; and more than 60 talks, including 12 invited plenary lectures.

en.profile: Oruc Allahverdiyev, who publishes as Yunusoğlu, is an associate professor of medical pharmacology at Bolu Abant İzzet Baysal University, a post he has held since December 2023. He received a PhD in medical pharmacology from Istanbul University in October 2014. The thesis compares varenicline and bupropion in morphine-conditioned place preference in rats, supervised by Ahmet Gökhan Akkan. His MSc in pharmacology and clinical pharmacology is from Istanbul University (July 2009), and his pharmacy degree is from the same university (July 2006). He was an assistant professor at Van Yüzüncü Yıl University from 2014 to 2021.

Oruc Allahverdiyev nəşrlərdə Yunusoğlu soyadı ilə çıxır. 2023-cü ilin dekabrından Bolu Abant İzzet Baysal Universitetində tibbi farmakologiya üzrə dosentdir. 2014-cü ilin oktyabrında İstanbul Universitetində tibbi farmakologiya üzrə PhD dərəcəsi alıb. Dissertasiya siçovullarda morfinlə şərtlənmiş yer üstünlüyündə vareniklin və bupropionu müqayisə edir. Elmi rəhbər Ahmet Gökhan Akkan-dır. Farmakologiya və klinik farmakologiya üzrə magistr dərəcəsini 2009-cu ilin iyulunda, əczaçılıq dərəcəsini 2006-cı ilin iyulunda İstanbul Universitetində alıb. 2014–2021-ci illərdə Van Yüzüncü Yıl Universitetində köməkçi professor olub.

en.profile: Suleyman Allahverdiyev heads the Laboratory of Controlled Photobiosynthesis at the K. A. Timiryazev Institute of Plant Physiology in Moscow. He also holds professorships and laboratory posts in Pushchino, at Lomonosov Moscow State University, the Moscow Institute of Physics and Technology, Bahçeşehir University in Istanbul, the Institute of Molecular Biology and Biotechnologies in Baku, al-Farabi Kazakh National University, and Foshan University. He graduated in physics from Azerbaijan State University in 1973, received the Candidate of Physical and Mathematical Sciences degree in biophysics in 1984, and the Doctor of Sciences degree in plant physiology and biochemistry in 2002. He was elected a corresponding member of the Russian Academy of Sciences in 2022.

Süleyman Allahverdiyev Moskva K. A. Timiryazev adına Bitki Fiziologiyası İnstitutunda idarə olunan fotobiosintez laboratoriyasının müdiridir. Puşşinoda, M. V. Lomonosov adına Moskva Dövlət Universitetində, Moskva Fizika-Texnika İnstitutunda, İstanbul Bahçeşehir Universitetində, Bakıda Molekulyar Biologiya və Biotexnologiyalar İnstitutunda, əl-Farabi adına Qazaxıstan Milli Universitetində və Foşan Universitetində də professor və laboratoriya vəzifələri var. 1973-cü ildə Azərbaycan Dövlət Universitetinin fizika fakültəsini bitirib, 1984-cü ildə biofizika üzrə fizika-riyaziyyat elmləri namizədi, 2002-ci ildə bitki fiziologiyası və biokimyası üzrə elmlər doktoru dərəcəsi alıb. 2024-cü ilin iyununa aid CV-də 450-dən çox məqalə, 41 kitab fəsli, 7 patent və 13 monoqrafiya, 30.000-dən çox istinad və h-indeks 85 göstərilir. 2022-ci ildə Rusiya Elmlər Akademiyasının müxbir üzvü seçilib.

Elşad Allahyarov Klivlenddəki Keys Qərbi Rezerv Universitetində fizika üzrə elmi işlər professorudur. Düsseldorfda Heinrich Heine Universitetində və Rusiya Elmlər Akademiyasının Yüksək Temperaturlar İnstitutunda da vəzifələri var. 2005-ci ildə Rusiya Elmlər Akademiyasında fizika və riyaziyyat üzrə elmlər doktoru dərəcəsi alıb. Dissertasiya The role of Coulomb correlations in colloids and biocolloids adlanır. CV bu dərəcəni alman Dr. habil. dərəcəsi ilə eyniləşdirir. 1994-cü ildə fizika üzrə fəlsəfə doktoru dərəcəsi alıb. CV bunu alman Dr. və ABŞ PhD dərəcəsi ilə eyniləşdirir. 1988-ci ildə Moskva Dövlət Universitetində fizika diplomu alıb. 2021–2025-ci illər üçün Alman Tədqiqat Cəmiyyətinin 300.000 avroluq qrantı kompozit elastomerlərin aktuasiyasına həsr olunub.

en.profile: Mark Applebaum is an associate professor in the Department of Mathematics and Teaching Mathematics at Kaye Academic College of Education, a post he has held since 2018. He received an MSc from Azerbaijan State University named after Kirov in Baku (1981–1986) and a PhD from Azerbaijan State Pedagogical University (1996–2001) for a dissertation on teaching mathematics through inquiry-based problems, supervised by Peter Samovol. He completed postdoctoral studies with Roza Leikin at the University of Haifa Faculty of Education in 2006–2007.

en.profile: Sevinj Asgerova is a professor and chief researcher at the N. I. Pirogov Russian National Research Medical University in Moscow. Her specialty is physician and ophthalmologist-surgeon. She defended a doctoral dissertation in 2005 at the S. N. Fyodorov Eye Microsurgery complex in Moscow. She is the author of 18 invention patents, 15 rationalization proposals, and more than 140 scientific articles and abstracts. Her honors include gold medals of Hippocrates and V. I. Vernadsky and the title Honored Worker of Science and Education. She is a full member of the European Society of Plastic and Reconstructive Ophthalmological Surgeons (ESOPRS) and holds memberships connected with the American Society of Ophthalmologists and the International Dacryological Society.

en.profile: Natig Atakishiyev is a researcher, with the rank Investigador Nacional Emérito, at the Institute of Mathematics of the National Autonomous University of Mexico in Cuernavaca, where he has worked since 1996. He received an MSc-equivalent diploma from Azerbaijan State University in 1961, a PhD-equivalent Candidate of Physical and Mathematical Sciences degree from the Institute of High Energy Physics in Serpukhov in 1971, and the Doctor of Physical and Mathematical Sciences degree from the Institute of Theoretical Physics in Kiev in 1987. From 1983 to 1994 he headed the Laboratory for the Theory of Elementary Particles at the Institute of Physics in Baku. His record includes 131 journal papers and 62 conference papers, with 2,825 citations and an h-index of 28.

en.profile: Elchin Badalov is an associate professor in the Department of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery at Istanbul Aydın University, where he has been a faculty member since 2014 and received the associate-professor title in 2023. He graduated from the Faculty of Dentistry of Istanbul University in 2007 and completed a doctorate there in oral implantology in 2014. His thesis is a histological and histomorphometric study of vascular endothelial growth factor and early bone growth in a mouse model. He has published more than 20 articles and book chapters in maxillofacial surgery and implantology, and has developed two surgical techniques and a suture method that carry his surname.

en.profile: Ismihan Bayramoglu is a professor at Izmir University of Economics, where he has worked since 2001. He was dean of the Faculty of Arts and Sciences from 2001 to 2022 and chair of the Department of Mathematics from 2001 to 2015. He received a PhD from Kiev State University in 1988 for a dissertation on invariant confidence intervals and statistical criteria based on training samples. He earned master’s and bachelor’s degrees in applied mathematics from Azerbaijan State University in 1981. From 1993 to 2001 he was a professor in the Department of Statistics at Ankara University. His publications also appear under the spelling Bairamov. He serves on the editorial boards of several international journals and as editor-in-chief of the Statistics journal.

en.profile: Elvin Afandi is division head for corporate strategy and research at the Islamic Corporation for the Development of the Private Sector of the Islamic Development Bank Group in Jeddah, a post he has held since January 2022. He has taught at Dar Al-Hekma University, Azerbaijan State University of Economics, and Khazar University.

en.profile: Messoud Efendiyev is rector’s distinguished visiting professor at Marmara University in Istanbul and head of the Department of Dynamical Systems at Helmholtz Zentrum München, with a guest and leading professorship linked to the Technical University of Munich. He received a PhD from Lomonosov Moscow State University in 1980 and a Dr. Sci. (habilitation) from the Free University of Berlin in 1998. He is the author of 8 books and an author or coauthor of 186 journal and conference papers. His research interests include infinite-dimensional dynamical systems, mathematical biology and medicine, and nonlinear equations of mathematical physics. In 2023 he received the Lifetime Achievement Award of the Fields Institute.

Lev Eppelbaum, PhD
Professor, Department of Geosciences
Tel Aviv University, Tel Aviv, Israel
en.profile: Lev Eppelbaum works in the Department of Geosciences at Tel Aviv University. He received an MSc in geophysics from Azerbaijan State University of Oil and Industry in 1982 and a PhD in geophysics in 1989 through the All-Union Geophysical Institute in Baku, the Institute of Geophysics of the Georgian Academy of Sciences in Tbilisi, and the Moscow Mining Academy. He completed postdoctoral studies at Tel Aviv University in 1991–1993 on interpretation and modeling of potential geophysical fields in the Dead Sea Rift. Since October 2020 he has been an honorary professor at Azerbaijan State Oil and Industry University. He has 7,192 Google Scholar citations and an h-index of 46. In 2018–2019 he received the Christian Huygens Medal of the European Geosciences Union. He is a member of the international geophysical commission “Rotation of the Earth” and of the WebmedCentral Ecology Advisory Board.

en.profile: Vahid Gadimov is a professor in the Department of Higher Mathematics and Programming at MIREA – Russian Technological University, and an acting professor at the Russian University of Transport. He earned a Dr. rer. nat. (Promotion A) in 1981 on contact problems of plastic flow in a thin metal layer, and a habilitation / Doctor of Science (Promotion B) in 2000 on nonstationary contact problems of flow in a thin plastic layer. He was a senior researcher and professor at the Institute of Mathematics and Mechanics in Baku from 1980 to 1997. He has more than 200 research publications and more than 45 textbooks, including 16 key works. He is a member of the international scientific societies GAMM and EUROMECH.

University of Tartu, Tartu, Estonia
en.profile: Khagani Gayibli is director of the Turkish Language Center at the University of Tartu, a post he has held since 1998. He received a PhD in history from the University of Tartu in 2008–2011 and an MA in Uralic languages there in 2003–2005. He has been chair of the Estonia-Azerbaijan Society since 1994 and a member and deputy chair of the board of the Congress of World Azerbaijanis since 2001. His publications include books of essays, poetry, and Turkish-Estonian language guides, as well as translations from Azerbaijani, Estonian, and Turkish. He was awarded the Taraggi Medal on 21 April 2022.

en.profile: Mehdi Genceli is an associate professor in the Department of Turkish Language and Literature at the Institute of Turkic Studies of Marmara University in Istanbul. He has held a faculty appointment there since 4 January 2012 and has been deputy director of the institute since 1 January 2018. He received a doctorate at the same institute (2002–2008) on the life, art, and works of the Azerbaijani poet Muhammad Hadi, supervised by Muhammet Gür, after a master’s degree there (1999–2002) and a bachelor’s degree in Turkish language and literature at Marmara University (1993–1999).

en.profile: Zahid Gojayev is deputy director for innovation and implementation at the Federal Scientific Agroengineering Center VIM and a professor at Moscow Polytechnic University and Bauman Moscow State Technical University. He is a Doctor of Technical Sciences and a corresponding member of the Russian Academy of Sciences, elected in 2019. He defended a Candidate of Technical Sciences dissertation at Bauman Moscow State Technical University in 1979 and a Doctor of Technical Sciences dissertation in 1994. He has received a letter of thanks from the President of the Russian Federation and honorary decrees of federal ministries.

en.profile: Aytakin Huseynli is an assistant research professor at the Brown School of Washington University in St. Louis, where she has worked since 2024. She was a postdoctoral scholar there in 2022–2024. She received a PhD from the Brown School in 2022. The dissertation is Exploring the Relationship between Resource Curse and Child Wellbeing, specifically in post-Soviet Countries, chaired by Michael Sherraden. She received an MSW from the Brown School in 2005 and a bachelor’s degree in English and German philology from Azerbaijan State University of Languages in 1995. She is also a regional household-survey consultant for UNICEF Europe and Central Asia.

en.profile: Rovshan Ibrahimov is a professor at Hankuk University of Foreign Studies, where he has worked since 2019, and a professor at Khazar University since 2023. He completed a PhD program in international relations at Ankara University in 2001–2008, on relations of the European Union with the states of the South Caucasus, and an MA at Ankara University’s Institute of the European Union in 1998–2001. He headed the Department of International Relations at Qafqaz University from 2003 to 2013 and was an associate professor there from 2011. He has been a member of the World Association of Azerbaijani Scientists since 2022.

en.profile: Rasim Jannataliyev is a project manager for intelligent energy systems at EnBW AG in Stuttgart, where he has worked since June 2013. He holds a PhD (Dr.-Ing.) from Azerbaijan Technical University (2004–2007). His thesis examined the thermal properties of heat-transfer fluids for absorption refrigeration machines and heat pumps. He works in German, Azerbaijani, Turkish, and Russian.

en.profile: Jamila Javadova-Spitzberg is an assistant professor at the University of Texas at Arlington, where she teaches organ and harpsichord. She holds a Doctor of Musical Arts degree in performance from the University of North Texas (2008), a Master of Music from the Azerbaijan State Conservatory (1986), and further qualifications from the Conservatorium van Amsterdam, the Associated Board of the Royal Schools of Music, and the Leopold Mozart Center in Augsburg. She performs on organ, harpsichord, and historical fortepiano, and in 2017 she founded the Azerbaijan-American Music Foundation, of which she is executive director. In 2022 she received the Tarraggi Medal of the Republic of Azerbaijan.

en.profile: Varga Kalantarov is professor in the Department of Mathematics at Koç University in Istanbul, where he has worked since 2001. He received a Doctor of Sciences in differential equations and mathematical physics from the V. A. Steklov Institute of Mathematics at St. Petersburg in 1988. The dissertation is Global behavior of solutions of nonlinear equations of mathematical physics of classical and non-classical types. He received a PhD in the same field in 1974 from the Institute of Mathematics and Mechanics of the Academy of Sciences of Azerbaijan. The dissertation is On mixed problem for semi-linear parabolic-hyperbolic systems. He studied at Azerbaijan State University in 1966–1971. From 1989 to 1993 he headed the Department of Partial Differential Equations at the Institute of Mathematics and Mechanics in Baku and was deputy director of the institute in 1984–1993.

en.profile: Saadat Karimi is a senior lecturer and course manager at the University of Borås, with a permanent appointment since January 2021, and a university lecturer at the University of Gothenburg since January 2016. en.profile: Saida Khalilova is founder and director of the Royal Conservatory of Music and Art in Muscat, a post she has held since November 2023, and an associate professor at the Baku Music Academy since October 2011. She received a PhD in music pedagogy from the Baku Music Academy in 2014 and a Master of Arts in music there in 1996. She taught piano at Sultan Qaboos University from 2011 to 2018 and at music colleges in Baku and Shusha. Her publications include a 2016 book and several papers on Elmira Aliyeva and piano education in Azerbaijan. She has developed more than 20 programs and served as author and artistic director of about 20 projects, competitions, and concerts, with appearances at the embassies of Japan, Turkey, France, and Russia.

Vefa Kurban, PhD
Professor
Institute of Turkish World Studies, Ege University, Izmir, Turkey
en.profile: Vefa Kurban is a professor at the Institute of Turkish World Studies of Ege University. She received a doctorate in the history of the Republic of Turkey from Ege University on 26 March 2007. The thesis is urbanization and settled life in Azerbaijan between 1900 and 1978, supervised by Tuncer Baykara. Her master’s thesis, on land ownership in Azerbaijan in the late nineteenth and early twentieth centuries, was completed on 23 June 2000. Her bachelor’s degree in history is from Ege University, dated 3 September 1997. She was an associate professor at Izmir University of Economics from 2007 to 2019 and at Ege University from 2015 to 2019.

en.profile: Afina Barmanbay is an associate professor of Azerbaijani Turkish and literature at Kafkas University in Kars. She was appointed associate professor on 20 January 2021. She completed an integrated doctorate at the Azerbaijan National Academy of Sciences in literature; her thesis, Ehmed Cavad ve Türkiye, was defended in 2010 with advisor Bekir Nebiyev, and the degree was awarded on 12 January 2011. She earned a bachelor’s degree in Azerbaijani language and literature from Azerbaijan State Pedagogical University (1989–1994). She was head of the department in 2017–2018.

Profil xülasəsi

Afina Barmanbay Qarsdakı Qafqaz Universitetində Azərbaycan türkcəsi və ədəbiyyatı üzrə dosentdir. Dosent elmi adı 20 yanvar 2021-ci il tarixlidir. Azərbaycan Milli Elmlər Akademiyasında ədəbiyyat üzrə inteqrə olunmuş doktoranturanı bitirib. Dissertasiya Ehmed Cavad ve Türkiye adlanır. 2010-cu ildə müdafiə edib. Elmi rəhbər Bəkir Nəbiyevdir. Dərəcənin tarixi 12 yanvar 2011-dir. Azərbaycan dili və ədəbiyyatı üzrə bakalavr dərəcəsini Azərbaycan Dövlət Pedaqoji Universitetində alıb. Tarix 7 iyul 1994-dür. Təhsil 1989-cu ildən başlayır. 2017–2018-ci illərdə kafedra müdiri olub.

Reza Moridi, PhD
Senior Fellow
Massey College, University of Toronto, Toronto, Canada
en.profile: Reza Moridi is a senior fellow of Massey College at the University of Toronto, a post he has held since 2020. He was Ontario’s Minister of Research, Innovation and Science in 2014–2016 and Minister of Training, Colleges and Universities, and he sat in the Ontario parliament for Richmond Hill from 2007 to 2018. He received a PhD in physics from Brunel University in 1975, an MTech in semiconductor physics and technology there in 1972, an MSc in nuclear physics from the University of Tehran in 1968, and a BSc in physics there in 1966. Odlar Yurdu University awarded him an honorary doctorate in 2017. He chaired the board of the Radiation Safety Institute of Canada from 2019.

en.profile: Shahriyar Mukhtarov is a professor in the Department of Economics at Korea University in Seoul, where he has worked since May 2024. He is also professor and head of the PhD program at Vistula University in Warsaw, a post he has held since August 2023, and professor at Khazar University in Baku since November 2023. He received a PhD from the Institute of Banking and Insurance at Marmara University in 2012–2016. The Supreme Attestation Commission under the President of the Republic of Azerbaijan confirmed the diploma on 27 April 2018 and awarded the associate professor title on 12 October 2021. His master’s degree is from Marmara University (2010–2012) and his bachelor’s degree in international economics is from Azerbaijan State University of Economics (2006–2010).

en.profile: Garib Murshudov is group leader at the MRC Laboratory of Molecular Biology in Cambridge, a post he has held since 2011, and head of a laboratory at the Institute of Molecular Biology and Biotechnologies in Baku. He received a PhD from the Institute of Crystallography in Moscow in 1989–1992. The thesis is the three-dimensional structure of catalase from Micrococcus lysodeikticus at 1.5 Å resolution. His first degree, in applied mathematics, is from Baku State University (1980–1985). Earlier he was a Wellcome Trust senior research fellow and a university research fellow at the University of York.

en.profile: Yashar Musayev is head of development for new energy business at Siemens Energy AG in Erlangen and Munich, an executive post he has held since May 2020. His work covers green hydrogen, electrolysis, fuel technology, and renewable energy, with about 32 direct reports. He holds a Dr.-Ing. from Friedrich-Alexander University Erlangen-Nuremberg (doctoral research, 1998–2001) and a Dipl.-Ing. in mechanical engineering technology from the Technical University of Azerbaijan (1984–1991), with distinction. From 2005 to 2020 he worked at Schaeffler AG, including as senior vice president and head of the Competency Center for Surface Technology from 2015 to 2020. He is a member of the Association of German Engineers (VDI) and has served as Chairman of the Board of BalticNet-Plasmatech e.V.

en.profile: Mirza Mutallimov is a specialist physician and associate professor in internal medicine and cardiology at Saarland University Hospital, and, since June 2019, head of department for internal medicine, cardiology, and rhythmology at Klinikum Idar-Oberstein, a teaching hospital of the University of Mainz. He trained in medicine in Baku from 2004 to 2011 and received German medical licensure (Approbation) in 2013. He was a doctoral student at the University of Cologne from December 2019 to March 2024; the dissertation, on the ECG in the diagnosis of diastolic heart failure, is dated 2024. He holds specialist recognition in internal medicine and cardiology, invasive electrophysiology, heart failure, and interventional cardiology. He is a Fellow of the European Society of Cardiology (FESC).

en.profile: Hajali Najafoglu is professor of inorganic chemistry at Kafkas University. He earned a doctorate in inorganic chemistry from the Azerbaijan Academy of Sciences and a master’s degree in organic chemistry and a first degree in chemistry from Azerbaijan State University. He was an assistant professor at Kafkas University in 1992–1995, an associate professor in 1995–1998, and a professor from 1998. Publications from the 1970s use the name G. N. Nadzhafov. At Kafkas University he has served as head of the Foreign Relations Office and as a member of the University Board, and has headed Caucasus and Central Asia–related academic units. He has supervised 11 PhD students and 19 master’s students. His Google Scholar metrics include an h-index of 25 and an i10-index of 82.

en.profile: Zarifa Osmanli is a postdoctoral fellow at BioComputing UP at the University of Padua, where she has worked since January 2024 on protein structure–function relations in cancer. She received a PhD in structural bioinformatics from the University of Montpellier and CRBM-CNRS in November 2019–December 2023, on bioinformatics tools for structural annotation of alternative proteomes. She holds an MSc in molecular biology from Ege University (2014–2017) and a BSc in biophysics from Baku State University (2009–2013).

en.profile: Aliheydar Rahimov is a professor in the Department of Anesthesiology and Intensive Care at I. M. Sechenov First Moscow State Medical University, a post he has held since 2021. He has also headed the Department of Transfusiology at the Russian Scientific Center of Surgery named after B. V. Petrovsky since 1992. He graduated from the N. Narimanov Azerbaijan State Medical Institute in 1976, received the Candidate of Medical Sciences degree in 1980, the Doctor of Medical Sciences degree in 1988, and the title of professor in hematology and blood transfusion in 1993. He has more than 390 scientific works, including 18 monographs and 13 textbooks; has supervised 15 candidate and six doctoral dissertations; and holds four inventions.

en.profile: Iouldouz Raguimov was a sessional associate professor, on a long-service teaching appointment, in the Department of Mathematics and Statistics at York University in Toronto from 2015 to 2024. He received an MSc in applied mathematics and computer science from Azerbaijan State University, now Baku State University, in 1975. In 1991 he received the science title Senior Research Fellow in applications of computational techniques, mathematical modeling, and mathematical methods. She served on the program committees of INFOCOMP 2013 (Lisbon) and INFOCOMP 2015 (Brussels).

en.profile: Eldar Veliyev is director of the center for training, retraining, and distance education at the Kharkiv National Academy of Municipal Economy, and a doctor of science and professor. He received an MSc in theoretical physics from Azerbaijan State University in 1968–1973. His thesis is diffraction radiation from a finite section of a circular waveguide. He received a PhD in radiophysics in 1977 from Kharkiv State University, supervised by V. P. Shestopalov, and a Doctor of Science in radiophysics there in 1988. From 1988 to 2008 he was a leading researcher at the Institute of Radiophysics and Electronics of the National Academy of Sciences of Ukraine.

Khadija Zeynalova, PhD

en.profile: Khadija Zeynalova is an associate professor at the Detmold University of Music and artistic director of the Bridge of Sound orchestra and of the Harmony of Sound festival, which she founded in Germany. She studied music theory at Sumgayit Music College (1990–1994) and composition and musicology at the Baku Music Academy (1994–2000), and continued composition studies in Detmold in 2005–2006. From 2006 to 2012 she was a doctoral student at the University of Paderborn; her thesis addresses Azerbaijani musical culture of the 20th century and tendencies in Western music. From 2000 to 2005 she taught as an associate professor at the Azerbaijan State University of Culture and Arts. Her record includes more than 40 books, works, and textbooks.

Xədicə Zeynalova Detmold Musiqi Akademiyasının dosenti, Almaniyada yaratdığı Bridge of Sound orkestrinin və Harmony of Sound festivalının bədii rəhbəridir. 1990–1994-cü illərdə Sumqayıt Musiqi Kollecində musiqi nəzəriyyəsi, 1994–2000-ci illərdə Bakı Musiqi Akademiyasında bəstəkarlıq və musiqişünaslıq oxuyub, 2005–2006-cı illərdə Detmoldda bəstəkarlıq təhsilini davam etdirib. 2006–2012-ci illərdə Paderborn Universitetində doktorant olub. Dissertasiya Azərbaycanın XX əsr musiqi mədəniyyəti və Qərb musiqisinin təmayülləri mövzusundadır. 2000–2005-ci illərdə Azərbaycan Dövlət Mədəniyyət və İncəsənət Universitetində dosent kimi dərs deyib. CV-də 40-dan çox kitab, əsər və dərslik qeyd olunur, siyahı verilmir.
